bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money for regional parks and trails.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; METROPOLITAN COUNCIL.

$11,050,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $21,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Metropolitan Council for grants to operate and maintain metropolitan area regional parks according to Minnesota Statutes, section 473.351.
additions: $11,050,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $21,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Metropolitan Council for grants to operate and maintain metropolitan area regional parks according to Minnesota Statutes, section 473.351.
